text: {"assertions":["Migration 0042_add_index.sql had a lock timeout issue that only affected clients still using the v1 SDK.","The root cause of the lock timeout in migration 0042 was two database writes that were not wrapped in a transaction.","The lock timeout in migration 0042 could be reproduced by running the migration against a loaded table.","The lock timeout manifested as a lock wait that exceeded the statement timeout limit.","The fix for migration 0042 wrapped both writes in a single transaction, implemented in PR #4746 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1.","Resolving the lock timeout in migration 0042 resulted in reclaiming 94 GB of blob storage.","Migration 0042_add_index.sql had been the site of previous lock timeout work in the same code area."]}
